response.rationale: Both capabilities are built around the same class, TreatmentService (node 2912145e8ad12343), and both cover hive treatments together with honey harvests. A is scoped to community:1 and adds the persistence classes TreatmentService uses (TreatmentRepository, HarvestRepository, ProductRepository). B is scoped to component:business and lists only TreatmentService. The wording differs: A says "compliance" and B says "recording". Even so, they describe one business function: managing treatments and harvests, including the check that harvests respect treatment rules. The difference looks like scope and phrasing rather than two separate capabilities.
